name: on-dig-net-tests
description: Dev-only manifest for the browser-asset unit tests. The site itself has NO build step and NO runtime dependency: assets/sw.js and assets/dig-embed.js are shipped verbatim. This exists so the URN conformance runner can read the shared table from @dignetwork/dig-sdk/conformance/urn-parse.json instead of copying it into this repo (a copied table is drift).
